traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and requirements for story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md are implemented and verified. The plugin exports a conventional ESLint plugin object with a dynamic rule registry and configuration presets, written in TypeScript and packaged for npm. Error handling for rule loading failures is robust and covered by tests. ESLint v9 flat config integration is implemented and exercised via CLI integration tests. Jest + ts-jest provides the required test infrastructure, and user/developer documentation describes installation, configuration, and plugin structure. The dedicated tests tagged to this story pass, so the foundational ESLint plugin setup is complete.
